UI_quick_tip1: Have you tried PZK Highway to Hell mod? It's adding lot of stuff - clothes, cars, mechanics, collectibles, music and plot to uncover
UI_quick_tip8: You can customize some pickups and trucks. You can craft and mount sideboards or tarp on bed.
UI_quick_tip9: Public Works flatbed can haul other small and medium vehicles.
UI_quick_tip18: There are unique vehicles across KY, find them all.
UI_quick_tip21: Check PZK VLC wiki - it's helpful website.
UI_quick_tip22: Create fortress on wheels and tune your engine with Standardized Vehicle Upgrades 3.
UI_quick_tip24: Clean water tankers have already pre-instaled water filters. You can fill them straight from rivers or lakes.
UI_quick_tip25: Septic tanks and fire trucks cannot be cleaned as they are contaminated. They will always contain tainted water.
UI_quick_tip26: Semi trucks and Towing trucks have high torque but low max speed.
UI_quick_tip27: Have you tried Project Indiana Expansion B42 already?
UI_quick_tip28: Milk truck, ice cream trucks have refrigerator or freezer. Be careful not to drain all vehicle battery.
UI_quick_tip29: Food trucks are equipped with electric ovens. You can cook your meal from passenger seat.
UI_quick_tip30: You can't repair you shoes or clothes? Make sure you use PZK repair all clothing mod.
UI_quick_tip31: With PZK Carzone workshop mod you can find rust solvent to remove rust from your vehicle.
UI_quick_tip32: Have you tried PZK Animeboid? Custom shaders, player skins and some QoL addons to enhance toony artwork.
UI_quick_tip33: Have you tried PZK New Coalfield map? A cosy village with some secrets.
UI_quick_tip34: Cabrio vehicles are great, rolling with style. But you are the meal on plate with wheels.
UI_quick_tip35: Have you tried mod Small Town First Responders? Its adding more cool regionalized vehicles and clothes!
UI_quick_tip36: With HDCP Immersive Vehicle Paint mod you can paint vehicles with different colors.
UI_quick_tip37: Have you tried mods that add to RV and other bigger vehicles full Interiors?.
UI_quick_tip38: If you are owerwhelmed by car wrecks - use Vehicle Repair Overhaul. Those wrecks are precious
UI_quick_tip39: Simple Wheels and Lightbars Expanded mod enchanting all vehicles and adding lot of cool customization parts.
UI_quick_tip40: Have you tried PZK Vehicle Pack Community Expansion mod?.
UI_quick_tip41: There is livestock semi trailer that can move your whole ranch.
UI_quick_tip44: An animal inside a Livestock Zone is automatically assigned to it, and will not leave even if the Zone is unfenced.
UI_quick_tip45: Smaller animals can be picked up and moved directly. Larger animals must be led around on a rope, and can be tied to a post/tree.
UI_quick_tip46: An animal will accept you the longer you stay with it. Petting it also helps (and reduces your stress).
UI_quick_tip47: Animals will eat food in their Zones, whether in a feeding trough or directly on the ground.
UI_quick_tip48: Animals can drink from puddles, troughs, or be given water from a container directly.
UI_quick_tip49: Some items can only be crafted on a table.
UI_quick_tip50: Some recipes are automatically learned if your skills are high enough.
UI_quick_tip51: Having a crafting recipe at hand will allow you to craft the item at one skill level lower.
UI_quick_tip52: Muscle strain from melee weapons can be lowered by increasing Strength, and/or your skill in that weapon type.
UI_quick_tip53: Double click a clothing item or weapon in your inventory to wear or equip it.
